caption: The drawing features a single object, an oil lamp, positioned upright in the center of a plain, light beige background. The lamp has a detailed and ornate design. At the top, there is a circular, flat lid colored gold with some darker shading for dimensionality. Beneath the lid, the body of the lamp is white with gray shading, showing two distinct levels: the upper section is smooth and rounded, while the lower section is also rounded but includes an embossed, textured ring with small oval shapes arranged in rows. Below this, there is a curved, decorative stem in gold with lighter highlights. The base of the lamp consists of a blue section shaped like an elongated vase, featuring sculpted details and curves. This blue section sits on a sturdy, rectangular, stepped base, which is also blue with varying shades to indicate depth and facets. No other objects or significant details are present in the drawing, and the lamp is depicted upright with careful shading and color contrast to depict its shape and materials.
title: Lamp
